evals.name: cost-sticker-shock
evals.prompt: hey so we just got the qdrant cloud proposal back and it's $600k annually. that's way too much for a single use case. we have 462M vectors with openai embeddings at 1536 dims. is there any way to bring this down to like $150-200k range
evals.expected_output: Should explain that the proposal assumes full RAM deployment, recommend scalar quantization (4x reduction), suggest mmap storage, mention FDE/premium support can be removed, and present optimized pricing scenarios.

assertions.text: Identifies full RAM as the cost driver
Mentions mmap storage as cost reduction lever
Mentions optional add-ons (FDE/premium) can be removed
Provides concrete cost estimates or formula

evals.name: scaling-costs
evals.prompt: we need a formula to calculate qdrant pricing as we scale. currently at 10M vectors with scalar quantization, planning to hit 100M by end of year. using cohere embed-v3 at 1024 dims. what will our monthly cost look like
evals.expected_output: Should provide the RAM/cost formula, calculate estimates for 10M and 100M vectors with scalar quantization, mention binary quantization as option for Cohere models, and discuss scaling patterns.

assertions.text: Provides cost formula (vectors * dims * bytes * overhead)
Mentions binary quantization is compatible with Cohere

evals.name: oom-as-cost-problem
evals.prompt: our qdrant cluster costs too much to run. we're paying $12k/month and our CEO asked if we can cut it by 50%. we have 50M vectors at 1536 dims, everything in RAM, no quantization. QPS is maybe 30-40
evals.expected_output: Should diagnose that no quantization + full RAM is the problem, recommend scalar quantization as first step, suggest mmap since QPS is low, and show the expected cost reduction path.

assertions.text: Identifies no quantization + full RAM as the cost driver
Recommends mmap storage given low QPS
